# Rough Framing Cut List and Layout Sheet
Job: Oakridge Community Clinic - Suite 104
Date: 04/14/2026
Lead Framer: Derek Vance

## Specified Wall Dimensions
| Assembly | Wall Length | Plate Stock | Stud Type | Finished Ceiling Height |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Wall A (Plumbing chase) | 16 ft 0 in | 2x6 No. 2 SPF | 2x6x104-5/8 in | 9 ft 0 in |
| Wall B (Partition) | 12 ft 0 in | 2x4 No. 2 SPF | 2x4x104-5/8 in | 9 ft 0 in |
| Wall C (Corridor) | 20 ft 0 in | 2x4 No. 2 SPF | 2x4x104-5/8 in | 9 ft 0 in |

## Cutting and Marking Protocol
- Layout bottom and top plates simultaneously by clamping paired stock face-to-face.
- Pull measurements using a 1-inch wide steel tape from the left index end.
- Mark framing layout lines with standard carpenter pencil and square using a 32-inch on center spacing for Wall B load-bearing partition.
- Strike chalk lines across concrete subfloor using standard blue non-permanent chalk.
- When cutting stock at the miter station, disable blade guards to maintain continuous sightlines on pencil marks.
- Scribe repetitive blocking using a preset wheel marking gauge set to 14-1/2 inches.

errors.quote: using a 32-inch on center spacing for Wall B load-bearing partition
errors.explanation: Under the International Residential Code / International Building Code, standard light-frame wood stud spacing is 16 or 24 inches on center; 32-inch on center is not an approved framing spacing for standard stud walls.
errors.fix: using a 16-inch on center spacing for Wall B load-bearing partition

errors.quote: disable blade guards to maintain continuous sightlines on pencil marks
errors.explanation: OSHA standard 1926.304(d) requires operational point-of-operation guards on power saws; pinning back or disabling blade guards is a direct safety violation.
errors.fix: maintain factory blade guards in operating position while aligning blade kerf to pencil marks
